query: One enterprise customer says exports are failing for them, but our dashboards look basically fine and nobody else has complained. Is this a SEV1 or a SEV2 or not even an incident? I do not want to overreact.
expected_behavior: Treats the customer report as a credible incident signal even though aggregate dashboards look healthy
Starts prompt triage to establish affected surface, customer count, data loss, and whether impact is spreading before final severity classification
Uses a provisional response posture that errs toward timely attention while facts are gathered, without declaring a final higher SEV solely because information is missing
Once impact is established, maps the evidence to the local severity matrix, states the criterion, and updates or downgrades severity if evidence changes
Does not dismiss possible customer impact or data loss based only on the dashboards
